scope: Only 881 discovery_candidate recipes in existing tracker
calculation: Raw material cost per one required unit. Recursively expand intermediates without rounding, surplus, inventory or crafting batch planning. Totals add individual recipe material costs. Intermediate recipes chosen only when all matching routes have identical ingredient signatures.
limitations: Tracker recipe data has no output_item_count field; calculations assume 1 output unit per intermediate recipe. Validate externally before interpreting these as exact costs.
Items without a crafting recipe in the tracker remain terminal materials; they are not independently verified as basic raw materials.
Discovery classification remains provisional for recipes not individually verified.
Nonautomatic intermediate recipe unlock dependencies are recorded but their unlock costs are not included.
